restore_and_archive_guidance.before_any_removal: Save these exact image IDs to a host-side image archive; export each stopped container filesystem if its writable layer is needed; store recreation metadata privately with secrets redacted from audit reports.
restore_and_archive_guidance.restore: Load the archived images and recreate the stopped containers under new names, attaching the existing named volume at /data. The source volume remains unchanged if the restore is only created; any started restore should use a read-only mount or a volume clone.
restore_and_archive_guidance.volume_handling: Never remove the shared volume as part of container removal. No volume export or content inspection was performed in this audit.
restore_and_archive_guidance.limits: Unique layer estimates are from Docker history uncompressed sizes, not measured Colima free-space deltas; uninspected non-Kingfisher images could share some layer data.
